headline: A federal law renames the Perryville, Arkansas post office after Harold George Bennett.
what_it_does: The law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 201 B Street in Perryville, Arkansas, the "Harold George Bennett Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change postal services, hours, fees, or mail delivery.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 13, 2016, and the renaming took effect on that date.
